analogy.rationale: Carboxamide antiepileptics (e.g., carbamazepine) primarily block voltage-gated sodium channels, so other sodium channel blockers and the related hydantoin antiepileptics should share the strongest transcriptional signature; local anesthetics also target sodium channels but with less overlap in downstream programs, while calcium channel blockers and GABA modulators are weaker mechanistic neighbors.
